title: Washiki Washoi!
description: A fast, colourful arena shooter in the Quake tradition, built on Babylon.js. Bunny hop, wall jump, ledge grab and slide through seventeen arenas in Duel, Free-for-All, Amphi and Search & Destroy, against other players or AI bots, with leaderboards and match replays.
how_to_play: Best with keyboard and mouse; controllers and touch controls are also supported. Quick Play starts a match with bots, so you can jump in alone. The game shows its key bindings in its settings and manuals.
